description: Field mapping for PADIH controller debug topic

field_mapping.4: Left wheel velocity command (output of the controller)
field_mapping.5: Right wheel velocity command (output of the controller)
field_mapping.6: Caster fork velocity command (output of the controller)
field_mapping.7: Caster wheel velocity command (output of the controller)
field_mapping.12: Current linear x command (should be teh same as Linear x command)
field_mapping.13: Current linear y command (should be teh same as Linear y command)
field_mapping.14: Current Angular z command (should be teh same as Angular z command)
field_mapping.15: Time difference between loops inside the controller. (Used to limit the ammount of commands per second)

notes: Edit field names to match your actual controller output
Verify against your controller code for accuracy
